uzo.purpose: A field that suggests matching values while the person types; the value may be one of the suggestions or, if allowed, free text; options of one group name it (attribute group) and stand under its heading.

instead.kialo: A handful of fixed options is a radio group, because a person sees them all at once and chooses without typing; suggestions help where the list is long.
A fixed list that typing does not shorten is a select, because the platform's list is enough and a person opens it with one click; suggestions help where the person knows a part of the word.

boundary.kialo: Several values in one field are the plurelektilo's, because it shows each chosen value, removes one and clears all (Spec 025 ③ closes the boundary multi-select).
Free tags typed one after another are a pattern of their own with a vocabulary behind them; Fundamento does not support them (Spec 014: Freitext-Tags are outside the scope).

containers.name: form
containers.kialo: A field with suggestions stands in a form among the other fields, because its value is sent with them.

with.kialo: A form with a field of suggestions is sent by a button, because the suggestions fill the field and the button sends the form.
A field with suggestions stands beside plain fields, because it is one of them with a list that helps typing.

case.de: Es gibt nur eine Handvoll fester Optionen, die alle sichtbar bleiben können.
case.en: There is only a handful of fixed options, which can all stay visible.

case.de: Die feste Liste wird durch Tippen nicht kürzer.
case.en: The fixed list does not get shorter by typing.

case.de: Mehrere Werte sollen im selben Feld gewählt werden.
case.en: Several values are to be chosen in the same field.

do.de: Schreib als Platzhalter eine Aufforderung aus mindestens zwei Wörtern, etwa „Land eingeben“.
do.en: Write a prompt of at least two words as the placeholder, such as “Enter country”.

do.de: Setze allow-free nur, wenn ein Text ohne passenden Vorschlag gültig ist.
do.en: Set allow-free only when a text without a matching suggestion is valid.

do.de: Setze loading, solange die Anwendung neue Vorschläge holt, und begrenze die Liste mit max-suggestions.
do.en: Set loading while the application fetches new suggestions, and limit the list with max-suggestions.

dont.de: Einen Wert als Platzhalter vorgeben, der wie eine Antwort aussieht.
dont.en: Put a value as the placeholder that looks like an answer.

dont.de: Freie Schlagwörter nacheinander tippen lassen; das unterstützt Fundamento nicht.
dont.en: Let free tags be typed one after another; Fundamento does not support that.

action.de: Öffnen die Vorschläge und markieren den nächsten oder vorigen, am Ende geht es von vorn weiter.
action.en: Open the suggestions and mark the next or previous one, wrapping at the end.

action.de: Übernimmt den markierten Vorschlag und schließt die Liste.
action.en: Takes the marked suggestion and closes the list.

action.de: Schließt die Vorschläge; der getippte Text bleibt stehen.
action.en: Closes the suggestions; the typed text stays.
